svg.aria-label: From qualitative evidence to strategic hypotheses. Completed within the review: group the evidence by theme against the HIV pathway; develop hypotheses about the causes and consequences of gaps; set out the evidence needed to test or prioritise them; examine them against published research and lived experience. Recommended, not part of the review: questions for further quantitative analysis, which the report proposed the Leadership Group request from Public Health England.
